WITH media_type_rates AS (
  SELECT
    MediaTypeId,
    AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price,
    AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS bytes_per_millisecond
  FROM Track
  WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId
),
media_type_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(bytes_per_millisecond) AS overall_avg_rate
  FROM media_type_rates
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_unit_price) AS avg_of_avg_unit_prices,
  AVG(bytes_per_millisecond) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond,
  AVG(bytes_per_millisecond - overall_avg_rate) AS avg_rate_above_average
FROM media_type_rates
CROSS JOIN media_type_average
WHERE bytes_per_millisecond > overall_avg_rate;
